items.name: SchemaProvider
items.signature: trait SchemaProvider: Any + Debug + Sync + Send
items.summary: Represents a schema, comprising a number of named tables.

methods.name: deregister_table
methods.summary: If supported by the implementation, removes the `name` table from this schema and returns the previously registered [`TableProvider`], if any.

methods.name: owner_name
methods.summary: Returns the owner of the Schema, default is None. This value is reported as part of `information_schema.schemata`.

methods.name: register_table
methods.signature: fn register_table(&self, name: String, table: Arc<dyn TableProvider>) -> Result<Option<Arc<dyn TableProvider>>>
methods.summary: If supported by the implementation, adds a new table named `name` to this schema.

methods.name: table
methods.signature: async fn table(&self, name: &str) -> Result<Option<Arc<dyn TableProvider>>, DataFusionError>
methods.summary: Retrieves a specific table from the schema by name, if it exists, otherwise returns `None`.

methods.name: table_exist
methods.summary: Returns true if table exist in the schema provider, false otherwise.

methods.name: table_names
methods.summary: Retrieves the list of available table names in this schema.

methods.name: table_type
